Strict adherence requires marking this as missing/mismatched. Crucially, for 'Legs are long and dark grey to black', the Router marked this false due to color. I must upgrade this to a structural failure: the feet are entirely absent/fused. A leg without a foot is anatomically incomplete, making the checkpoint fail on anatomy, not just color. The Router's artifact assessment of missing feet (Severity 5) is correct and supported by the pose auditor's low confidence in hind limb keypoints (0.31-0.45). The topology auditor's high mask score is a false negative caused by the fusion of leg and branch into one segment.

This is corroborated by the animal_pose_auditor showing 29% low-confidence keypoints concentrated in the hind limbs. The texture anomaly on wings (Severity 2) is valid but secondary. The perceptual quality auditor noted 'slight darken' which aligns with the smudged appearance of the pink feathers. I maintain the Severity 5 rating for missing parts as it fundamentally breaks the biological plausibility of the scene.
